First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Columbia Cycling Club Saturday Ride group ride

Saturday road rides in three groups. The A group goes about 50 miles and runs through winter. B and C groups ride 20 to 45 miles from March to October. The club's rule is no rider left behind, with regroups before turns. You should be able to ride 20 miles before joining.
